title: Remove remaining Launch flat aliases
summary: Removed the final eleven Launch page flat window aliases while preserving the helpers on window.mediaPipelineLaunchView. Updated Launch browser/static probes, the public contract baseline, current flat-export totals, the global export inventory, and generated summaries.
reason: Continue opportunistic WebView flat export cleanup in the touched Launch domain without changing backend routes, media policy, source files, pending-publish behavior, or mutation ownership.
behavior_before: launchView.js still assigned eleven Launch helper aliases directly to window for selected browser/static smoke probes.
behavior_after: Launch helpers are available through window.mediaPipelineLaunchView only; launchView.js has zero flat exports, and the current WebView flat-export inventory is 648 exports across 51 files.
tests_added: Tightened existing Local API/WebView static assertions to require the remaining Launch helpers through mediaPipelineLaunchView and assert the removed flat aliases are absent.
Moved Launch queue-readiness browser-smoke helper probes from direct window globals to mediaPipelineLaunchView namespace members.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -B -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_launch_queue_readiness_smoke.WebViewBrowserLaunchQueueReadinessSmoke.test_real_browser_renders_launch_queue_readiness_without_mutation_posts -q (first run failed on embedded smoke-script backtick syntax; fixed probe error string and reran OK)
rollback_plan: Restore the eleven removed window.<Launch helper> assignments in apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/launchView.js, move the browser/static probes back to flat globals, regenerate the WebView public contract, restore inventory/current-state flat-export totals, refresh summaries, and rerun the same WebView static/API/browser checks.
